paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s annual Christmas tree lighting is scheduled for 6 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 19, at the Pontotoc Community House, followed by two holiday shopping events later in the month.
The Chamber’s 2026 events schedule lists cookies, cocoa, caroling, popcorn and Santa among the plans for the lighting ceremony.
Christmas Open House is set for noon to 5 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 22, in Pontotoc.
Feast Then Fashion follows on Thanksgiving night, Thursday, Nov. 26. The shopping event is presented by the Pontotoc Retailers. The Chamber says hours will vary.
